collection.description: Gold tablets buried with Orphic or Bacchic initiates, telling the soul which spring to avoid in the underworld and what to say to the guardians of Memory, shown on a photograph of the tablet with a public-domain Greek text and translation.

texts.title: Orphic gold tablet from Petelia: the springs of Forgetfulness and Memory
texts.source: British Museum 1843,0816.1 (photograph Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0) + Greek and English from J. E. Harrison, Prolegomena to the Study of Greek Religion (1903)
texts.description: A gold tablet of the 4th century BCE from a grave near Petelia in southern Italy, instructing the dead soul to avoid the first spring by the white cypress and to ask the guardians of the Lake of Memory for water: 'I am a child of Earth and of Starry Heaven, but my race is of Heaven (alone)'.
